title: Modeling Network Congestion under Demand Uncertainty Using Wardrop Principles
summary: Motivated by the need for reliable traffic management under fluctuating travel demand, we study the problem of determining the worst-case congestion in a multi-commodity traffic network subject to demand uncertainty. To this end, we stress-test a given network by identifying demand realizations and corresponding travelers' route choices that maximize congestion.
